schema_name: TAGMOS public schema v4.5.13 FORMULA A FULL16
license: TAGMOS Public Research License v1.0 (non-commercial research only · mandatory citation)
primary_citation: Soverini M., et al. Functional multi-axis decomposition of the human gut microbiome. bioRxiv 2026. doi:[TBD]
description: Public release of the TAGMOS substrate-functional framework: 14 single-output axes + 7 sub-axes + 151 bottleneck EC entries + 36-cell three-dimensional state-space. Numeric calibration parameters (mean / sigma / quartile / tertile cuts) are NOT shipped with this schema — they are computed on the user's own cohort following the calibration recipe in 03_CALIBRATION_RECIPE/.

ENG.label: Engine z
ENG.composition: normalised hydrogen-disposal balance: three eubiotic sub-axes (Wood-Ljungdahl acetogenesis, hydrogenotrophic methanogenesis, sulfate reduction) vs three dysbiotic sub-axes (aerobic respiration, denitrification, dissimilatory nitrate reduction to ammonium)
ENG.tier_label_convention: T1 = highest quartile of Engine z (most eubiotic) · T4 = lowest quartile (most dysbiotic)

SYN_cof.label: SYN_cof
SYN_cof.composition: deterministic z-mean of four single sub-axes: B12 (cobalamin biosynthesis / consumption / transport), K2 (menaquinone biosynthesis), POL (polyamine biosynthesis: putrescine, cadaverine, agmatine chains), GABA (γ-aminobutyrate production via GAD)

SYN_carb.label: SYN_carb
SYN_carb.composition: z-mean of three single sub-axes: BUT (butyrogenic activity — taxonomy-first via the F. prausnitzii / Roseburia / E. rectale / E. ramulus / Dorea / Coprococcus curated panel), PRP (propanediol-propionate pathway), LAC (lactate racemase / stereo-balance)
SYN_carb.BUT_input_method: TAX (curated species panel + 4 racemase / propanediol ECs)

TRP.label: TRP · tryptophan-derived signalling
TRP.direction_of_concern: positive pole = elevated indole / IAA / tryptamine route
TRP.composition: indole route (tryptophanase) + kynurenine route + tryptamine + IAA

HIS.label: HIS · histamine net
HIS.direction_of_concern: positive pole = net histamine production > degradation
HIS.composition: HDC (production) − HAL − NAT (degradation routes) = net histamine

UREM.label: UREM · uremic / phenolic precursors
UREM.direction_of_concern: positive pole = elevated p-cresol + indoxyl precursors

LPS.label: LPS · lipopolysaccharide signalling
LPS.direction_of_concern: positive pole = elevated hexa-acylated LpxLM LPS signature

ec_dictionaries_inventory._note: Each axis is computed as the log1p-mean (or z-mean of log1p) of the per-EC counts in the dictionaries listed below. EC identifiers follow IUBMB EC nomenclature (Level-4). The full per-dictionary EC lists are in ec_dictionaries.md.
ec_dictionaries_inventory.H_sink_acetogenesis_WL: Wood-Ljungdahl reductive acetyl-CoA pathway · diagnostic ECs: 1.2.7.4 (Ni-Fe CODH), 2.3.1.169 (CO-methylating acetyl-CoA synthase)
ec_dictionaries_inventory.H_sink_dysbiotic: alternative-electron-acceptor sinks · diagnostic ECs: 7.1.1.9, 7.1.1.7 (aerobic respiration), 1.7.1.15, 1.7.2.2, 1.7.5.1, 1.7.2.1, 1.7.1.4, 1.9.3.1 (denitrification / DNRA)
ec_dictionaries_inventory.Polyamine_putrescine_branch: putrescine biosynthesis branch (ornithine decarboxylase, arginine decarboxylase)

state_space_36_cells._note: Cross-product Engine z (4 tiers) × SYN_cof (3 classes) × SYN_carb (3 classes) = 36 cells

FORMULA_A_FULL16.description: primary clinical layer — 14 single-output axes only, no composite metrics. This is the layer used in the primary TAGMOS publication.

FORMULA_B_research.description: research extension layer — 14 single-output axes + composite indices (MUC_INFLAM, BAI_MCAS, PATHOBIONT_triple, TMA_net, EUB_complete_resilience). Composite metrics are derived from single-output z-scores using formulas documented in 02_VERSION_B_WITH_COMPOSITE/composite_definitions.md

calibration_anchor_disclosure._note: This public schema deliberately does NOT contain calibration numerics. The frozen calibration parameters of the Wellmicro Italian RWE 6,508-subject anchor (per-axis mean, standard deviation, quartile / tertile cuts) are held as proprietary calibration parameters of Wellmicro S.r.l. and are not released here. Users of this bundle are expected to compute their own calibration on their own cohort following the recipe in 03_CALIBRATION_RECIPE/.
